vendor: Phrase a.s. (formerly Memsource a.s.) and Phrase GmbH (formerly PhraseApp GmbH)
product_family: Phrase Localization Platform: enterprise translation/localization management (Phrase Platform / TMS), a translator workbench (Phrase Studio, on GCP), developer-focused in-context string management (Phrase Strings), and AI machine-translation engines (NextMT, Next GenMT, Custom NextMT) plus an AI quality-estimation feature (QPS).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: Phrase is SOC 2 Type I certified, with Type II certification expected in 2026.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Type II certification expected in 2026 (not yet issued at time of review).

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Phrase a.s. has been certified for ISO 27001 which proves that the information security management system (ISMS) which we have introduced conforms to the ISO standard.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy Notice describes Phrase acting as data controller and processor, use of Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission for international transfers, and data subject rights aligned to GDPR; trust center lists GDPR under Compliance.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: We engaged an independent and recognized third-party auditor, CyberGRX, who verified our compliance with HIPAA through a comprehensive assessment of our privacy and security processes.

certifications.name: TISAX
certifications.proof_quote: Trust center Compliance list includes 'TISAX' and Resources include 'TISAX Assessment.pdf'.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 certification; trust center lists 'EU AI ACT' as a compliance topic (a regulation, not a certification) but no AI management-system certificate is referenced.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Phrase itself is not PCI DSS certified; the security page states payment processing is handled by 'a third-party payment provider that is PCI DSS compliant.' Phrase markets alignment with PCI DSS 'Principles and Security Statements' on its homepage but holds no PCI DSS certification of its own.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / 27018 / 27701
certifications.proof_quote: Not listed on trust center or security page; only ISO 27001:2022 is referenced.

privacy.ai_training_note: Varies by feature. QPS (quality estimation): 'We use Customer Content to train and periodically retrain the AI... Customer Content that is used to train QPS is also not retained; we implement a regular deletion of training data.' Phrase NextMT and Next GenMT: 'We do not use any Customer Content, content or translations in the training or retraining of this AI model.' Custom NextMT (opt-in custom engine): 'Customer Content is used in the training and periodic retraining of the AI feature.' No explicit opt-out mechanism is described for QPS training.
privacy.data_region: Phrase Platform is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS); Phrase Studio is hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). No explicit customer-selectable data-residency region (e.g. EU-only) was found in public documentation; not verified.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual third-party penetration tests conducted in accordance with the OWASP ASVS standard; '2025 Pentest' report listed in trust center.

security.name: Hosting infrastructure
security.value: Phrase Platform on AWS; Phrase Studio on Google Cloud Platform data centers.

security.name: Multi-factor authentication
security.value: Listed as a Product security control in the trust center.

security.name: Subprocessor disclosure
security.value: Public subprocessor list maintained and linked from the privacy policy.

products.name: Phrase Platform (TMS)
products.data_scope: Source content, translation memories, terminology, style guides stored on AWS.
products.notes: Core enterprise product; used by Uber, Zendesk, Volkswagen per vendor homepage.

products.name: Phrase Studio
products.data_scope: Translation content and project data, hosted on GCP.
products.notes: Separate hosting provider (GCP) from the main platform (AWS).

products.name: Phrase Strings
products.data_scope: Software UI strings, CI/CD integration data.
products.notes: Has its own self-serve signup flow distinct from the enterprise demo-request flow.

products.name: NextMT / Next GenMT (machine translation)
products.notes: Vendor states customer content is not used to train or retrain these base MT models.

products.name: Custom NextMT
products.data_scope: Customer-provided translation data, opted in for custom model training.
products.notes: Customer content IS used to train/retrain this specific opt-in engine.

products.name: QPS (Quality Performance Score)
products.data_scope: Customer content used transiently to train/retrain scoring model.
products.notes: Vendor states training data is regularly deleted and not retained; output is a 0-100 score, not retrievable customer content.

compare.pricing_model: Primarily enterprise quote/demo-request for the core Platform; Phrase Strings offers self-serve signup/trial.
compare.data_residency: AWS (Platform) and GCP (Studio) hosting; no publicly documented customer-selectable region/residency option found.

flags: SOC 2 is Type I only; Type II is not yet issued (the vendor states it is expected in 2026), so the 'SOC 2' badge should specify the Type I qualifier.

HIPAA 'compliance' is based on a third-party assessment by CyberGRX, not a government-issued or industry-standard HIPAA certification (none exists for SaaS vendors); it should be presented as third-party assessed HIPAA compliance rather than a formal certification.

AI training posture is feature-specific: QPS and Custom NextMT use Customer Content for training (QPS data is not retained; Custom NextMT data is retained and retrained), while NextMT and Next GenMT do not. A blanket 'does not train on your data' claim would be inaccurate.
Primary certificate and report documents (the ISO 27001 certificate, SOC 2 report, and penetration test report) are gated behind an NDA request in the trust center.

Trust center groups 'EU AI ACT' under the same 'Compliance' heading as GDPR/SOC2/ISO, which could read as an implied certification; EU AI Act is a regulation, not a certifiable standard, and no ISO/IEC 42001 AI-management certification was found.
